title: Short-horizon mean reversion in cryptocurrency markets: a matched cross-market measurement
abstract: arXiv:2608.21888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: At 15-minute horizons, directional mean reversion is far stronger and more pervasive in cryptocurrency markets than in US equities: scored under one matched, strictly out-of-sample protocol, 90% of 183 Binance pairs carry significant directional reversal against 2.7% of 187 US stocks and ETFs, in every focal coin-year since 2021. The signal lives in signs, not magnitudes: lag-one return autocorrelation is near zero on the major coins, yet simply betting against the previous candle captures most of the effect. US-listed funds whose net asset value is a crypto or metal price inherit their underlying's reversal, including its absence, from their first months of trading; stocks merely correlated with the same underlyings inherit nothing: descriptive evidence that a wrapper's tape reads like the process it wraps, not the venue it prints on. On the originating tape, the reversal concentrates after moves driven by aggressive taker flow and grow

translated_title: 加密货币市场中的短期均值回归：一项匹配的跨市场测量
translated_abstract: 在15分钟的时间尺度上，加密货币市场的方向性均值回归远比美国股市更强且更普遍：在一种匹配的、严格样本外协议下，自2021年以来，183个币安交易对中有90%表现出显著的方向性反转，而187只美国股票和ETF中仅有2.7%。该信号存在于符号而非幅度中：主要币种的一阶滞后收益自相关性接近零，但仅通过押注前一根K线方向就能捕捉大部分效应。在美国上市的基金，其净资产价值基于加密货币或金属价格，从交易首月起便继承了其基础资产的回归特性（包括其缺失）；而仅与相同基础资产相关的股票则不继承任何特性：这描述性证据表明，包装工具的行情记录读取的是其包装的流程，而非其挂牌的交易所。在原始行情上，反转集中在由激进吃单者流动驱动的移动之后，并进一步加剧。
tldr: 本研究通过匹配的样本外协议发现，加密货币市场在15分钟时间尺度上表现出远强于美股的方向性均值回归，且该效应源于符号而非幅度，并揭示了资产包装工具继承基础资产而非交易场所的行情特征。
en_tdlr: This study finds that cryptocurrency markets exhibit far stronger directional mean reversion at 15-minute horizons than US equities under a matched out-of-sample protocol, with the effect residing in signs rather than magnitudes, and reveals that wrapped assets inherit their underlying's tape behavior rather than their listing venue's.
